name: AlphaGenome pre-training and distillation compute
description: Descriptive fact transcribed from the pinned source.

attributes.value: Pre-training used TPU v3 with 8-way sequence parallelism (each 1 Mb interval split across 8 TPU cores); each gradient step of 64 samples required 512 TPUv3 cores, and a pre-training run of 15,000 steps typically completed in about 4 hours. Distillation ran without sequence parallelism on 64 NVIDIA H100 GPUs (batch size 64, one sample per GPU) for 250,000 steps, taking about 3 days.

description: Descriptive fact transcribed from the pinned source.

attributes.value: All models were trained on Cambridge-1 (16 nodes of eight A100 GPUs, 128 GPUs).
